objective: Return home to Emberwood: Hisame has something to teach you
title: What the Scroll Remembers
summary: The night before the new moon, Hisame opens the scroll to its oldest technique, and everyone says what they've been carrying.

say: You came back. I wasn't sure you would, after what he told you.

lines: You said you'd teach me something no one has used in a hundred years.
The founders' own binding. The Five-Nature Seal. Rat, Tiger, Dragon, Snake, Boar.
Five natures woven into one circle. It is how they tore the Nue apart the first time. It will cost you nearly everything you have.
Tomorrow you'll weave it while the Nue screams at you. Tonight you'll weave it while I watch. Twice.

beats.text: Weave the Five-Nature Seal: Rat, Tiger, Dragon, Snake, Boar (hold {weave}; {charge_chakra} charges chakra)

lines: ...The founders would have liked you. They were stubborn too.
I saw the light from the wall. Was that the seal? It looked expensive.
Iwao told the Watch everything. The new moon is tomorrow night. The Watch wants Kagerou dead before it rises.
The Watch can want what it likes. He's coming home.
And if he doesn't want to?
Then I drag him home. I should have done it years ago.

say: I'm scared. Not of the clones. Of being the one who isn't fast enough when it matters.
Everyone on a summit is scared, Asahi. The brave ones climb anyway.
...That was almost nice. Are you feeling all right?

lines: Five Winds. The summit stands far to the north, past the dam. Leap stones at the foot of its southern cliffs will carry you up.
We meet at the top at dusk. Sleep if you can. I won't.
